name: xgo
description: XGo is a programming language that reads like plain English. But it's also incredibly powerful — it lets you leverage assets from C/C++, Go, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript, creating a unified software engineering ecosystem. Our vision is to enable everyone to become a builder of the world.

latest_release.name: v1.7.5
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

feature [enum type](https://github.com/goplus/xgo/issues/2751):
* cl compileType: support enum type decl in func by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2782
* cl loadConsts: if not untyped, convert value to the enum type by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2784
* cl: allow same names across different enum types (#2787) by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2790

feature [static member](https://github.com/goplus/xgo/issues/2513):
* ast: add ValueSpec.HasStatic (#2513) by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2785
* ast: mv methods by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2789
* feat(syntax): add static value declarations by @KurodaKayn in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2783
* parser: static member refactor by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2793
* parser: TestErrType, TestErrStaticMember by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2794
* parser: TestErrStaticMember add cases by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2795

feature [function decorator](https://github.com/goplus/xgo/issues/2797):
* cl: implement Phase 2 semantic support for function decorators by @fennoai[bot] in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2801
* syntax: Phase 1 - Grammar Definition for Function Decorators by @fennoai[bot] in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2799

feature [flat mode for XGo class framework](https://github.com/goplus/xgo/issues/2802):
* cl genClassProjectMain fix (flat): narg = 2 by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2805
* cl: implement flat mode for XGo class framework by @fennoai[bot] in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2804

documents:
* doc: class framework (refactor) by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2796
* doc/classfile: details by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2800
* README: rm Report Card by @xushiwei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2811

changes:
* fix: handle XGo AST extension nodes consistently by @aofei in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2806
* cl: resolve embedded work class names in class field initializers by @fennoai[bot] in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2817

deps:
* build(deps): bump github.com/goplus/mod 0.20.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2786
* build(deps): bump github.com/goplus/gogen 1.23.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2807

ci & tools:
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-go from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2813

## New Contributors
* @KurodaKayn made their first contribution in https://github.com/goplus/xgo/pull/2783

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/goplus/xgo/compare/v1.7.3...v1.7.5
